notes: Primary: Sony's CFI-7021 safety guide (en-gb) PDF, specifications page, text via macOS PDFKit (pypdf extracts nothing from it). Axes labelled (width × height × depth), excluding projecting parts. The safety guide's 'Mass Approx. 280 g' further down is the DualSense controller, not the console.

ports = the guide's Input/output, Networking and AV output rows. The 'M.2 SSD expansion connector (Key M)' is filed as expansion (count 1); the 'Disc drive port' (where the separately sold drive attaches) has no §3 kind and is not filed. The inlet is not named in the table; no power_in item.
media = []: the Pro ships without a disc drive (reveal release, 2024-09-10). stand_included false: the guide calls the vertical stand 'sold separately' (it ships with feet for horizontal placement).
